# Environment Artwork — M014

`forge-hall.jpg` (production, 1920×1280, ~117KB) and
`forge-hall-source.jpg` (original output) are original AI-generated
artwork created for ROOKWELD FieldRook milestone M014
("cinematic atmosphere") via the project's image-generation tooling.

- Subject: abstract dark industrial-technology environment plate —
  out-of-focus metallic masses on the edges, distant warm amber
  glow low-left, faint cyan instrument lights high-right, near-black
  center reserved as the UI reading well.
- No text, people, animals, trademarks, or third-party artwork.
- Production file is a quality-70 re-encode of the source; no other
  alteration. The interface dims it further and keeps all text on
  opaque surfaces or the shadow well.
- Provenance: generated 2026-10-27 for this repository; treat as
  project-owned artwork under the repo license (Apache-2.0).
